method: March 3, 2026 Democratic and Republican primary ballots cast, all voting modes, from county-published aggregate reports. Democratic share is Democratic ballots / (Democratic + Republican ballots), summed over complete native 26P precincts before forming common-geographic-group percentages. This is primary participation, not party registration or November party preference. Dallas uses Clarity VoterTurnout ballotsCast with explicit party suffixes removed; Montgomery, Hays, and McLennan use the explicit Total Ballots Cast column; Ellis uses party Ballots Cast statistics. Madison uses visually verified explicit Total Ballots Cast columns from a scanned canvass, reconciled to the signed official combined total; its stale page header is not used. Denton uses explicit Total Ballots Cast in its official party canvasses. Tarrant uses explicit precinct ballots-cast headers; Harris uses Total Ballots Cast; Bexar and Collin use party-specific Ballots Cast statistics. Collin publishes a precinct report short of its county summary by 15 Democratic and 11 Republican ballots; these unlocated ballots remain excluded. Candidate-vote sums are never substituted. Limited/federal-only records without a native precinct match and missing precincts are excluded, never assigned by area or assumed zero. No voter-level records are read or retained.
